_readme: The warp gate: walk east out of the town, arrive in the cave, and walk back.
It asserts which MAP the player is in rather than which tile. A tile assertion would
be pinned to how far a held key carried them after the transition - which is a fact
about the test's timing, not about warping.
The round trip is the point. A one-way test would pass with a warp that fires on
every frame the player stands on it - which, with a door at each end, bounces them
between two maps forever and looks like a freeze.

steps.text: walk east through the town gate
standing still must NOT send us straight back
walk west onto the cave's own door and return
and the town has not sent us straight back either
